source: Captured 2026-10-14 from a real SIP call into the LiveKit Cloud project: a baresip softphone on this Mac dialled the project's SIP URI over TCP through a temporary inbound trunk (auth only, no numbers, media encryption off) and dispatch rule, both deleted after the call. Codec on the phone leg PCMU 8 kHz. Agent run locally in dev mode; its observability upload (decision 0014) gave the spans, chat_history.json and the stereo recording.ogg. The caller audio is synthetic speech from a file.

call.endReason: the SIP connection was reset from LiveKit's side after 1 min 4 s; cause not visible
